About the
NW River Trail
Discover Lancaster County’s Scenic Northwest Waterfront

NORTHWEST RIVER
TRAIL GUIDE

The Northwest Lancaster
County River Trail is a fourteen-mile, multi-use,
recreation trail along the Susquehanna River.
The trail spans five municipalities on land owned
by several local governments and agencies.
Please contact the appropriate trail manager with
questions or concerns:
Columbia Borough: 717-684-2467
Conoy Township: 717-367-4927
East Donegal Township: 717-426-3167
Marietta Borough: 717-426-4143
Lancaster County Dept. of Parks & Recreation:
717-299-8215
Emergencies: Call 911

• Enjoy the trail at your own risk. The
trail is open year round, dawn to dusk,
conditions permitting.
• Motorized vehicles are prohibited except
for emergency and maintenance vehicles.
• The trail is available for walking, bicycling,
jogging, cross-country skiing, and
snowshoeing.
• Pets must be kept on a leash at all times.
Owners are responsible for removing all
pet waste.
• Keep the trail clean – carry out all waste.
• Alcoholic beverages are prohibited.
• Use caution when crossing bridges,
roads, and railways, because they are
actively used.
• Stay to the right on the trail and warn
when passing.
• Please do not disturb natural habitats.
• Discharging of weapons on or from
the trail is prohibited. Hunting may be
permitted on adjacent lands.
• Other borough, township, or park ordinances
shall be in effect.
• Individuals with mobility disabilities should refer to the trail’s ADA
accessibility policy regarding the use of powered mobility devices on the
trail. This policy is available at municipal offices and on Lancaster
County’s website at: co.lancaster.pa.us/DocumentCenter.
